SELECT pb.pb_id pbId, pb.factor_type factorType, dict.item_value factorTypeStr, pb.prd_portfolio_id prdPortfolioId, DECODE(pb.factor_type,'0',fin.finprod_name,ptl.portfolio_name) prdPortfolioName, pb.update_time updateTime, to_char(pb.update_time,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') updateTimeStr, sysuser.real_name updateUser, pb.seqno FROM TRD_PB_RELATION pb LEFT JOIN ptl_portfolio ptl ON pb.prd_portfolio_id=ptl.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fin ON pb.prd_portfolio_id=fin.FINPROD_ID AND fin.finprod_type2 = 'F16' LEFT JOIN sys_datadict_list dict ON dict.dict_code ='FACTOR_TYPE' AND pb.factor_type =dict.item_code Left join sys_user sysuser on sysuser.user_name=pb.update_user
ORDER BY pb.update_time

SELECT pb.pb_id pbId, pb.factor_type factorType, dict.item_value factorTypeStr, pb.prd_portfolio_id prdPortfolioId, DECODE(pb.factor_type,'0',fin.finprod_name,ptl.portfolio_name) prdPortfolioName, to_char(pb.update_time,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') updateTimeStr, sysuser.real_name updateUser, pb.seqno FROM TRD_PB_RELATION pb LEFT JOIN ptl_portfolio ptl ON pb.prd_portfolio_id=ptl.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fin ON pb.prd_portfolio_id=fin.FINPROD_ID AND fin.finprod_type2 = 'F16' LEFT JOIN sys_datadict_list dict ON dict.dict_code ='FACTOR_TYPE' AND pb.factor_type =dict.item_code Left join sys_user sysuser on sysuser.user_name=pb.update_user
ORDER BY pb.update_time

SELECT DISTINCT B.FINPROD_ID id, B.FINPROD_NAME text, B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID object FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE (B.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL OR B.P_FINPROD_ID = '')
AND B.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE}
and ( B.FINPROD_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR B.FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL deal WHERE deal.ps IN('C5','C20') AND deal.FINPROD_ID=A.FINPROD_ID )
